SELECT
  TO_CHAR(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS order_date,
  ABS(SUM(p.payment_value)) AS total_revenue
FROM
  orders o
JOIN
  order_payments p
  ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE
  o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
ORDER BY
  CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) ASC;
